title: Your written practice plan
instructions: Write a demo-only plan covering your available time, EUR/USD, the H4/H1 experimental rules, risk limits, and when you will deliberately sit out.

title: Pips, costs and position sizing
instructions: Work through ten distinct hypothetical EUR/USD position sizes. Include spread, commission, lot increment and broker minimums. A size below the minimum means skip; never round up.

title: Confirmed H4 structure
instructions: Annotate ten historical charts. Identify swing highs and lows with two closed candles on each side. Describe when confirmation became available; avoid look-ahead assumptions.

title: H4 zones and closed H1 candles
instructions: Annotate ten more charts. Describe the pre-existing H4 zone, the closed H1 candle and a reason to accept further study or skip. These are learning annotations, not eligibility evaluations.

title: Sequential sampling
instructions: Document how you will select consecutive historical candidates without cherry-picking wins. Separate development and untouched held-out data.

title: Development log
instructions: Reflect on the first 35 candidates and how spread, commission, timestamps and excluded news windows will be documented. Candidate validation belongs to the setup journal.

title: Freeze before held-out testing
instructions: Document the exact strategy version to freeze after 70 development samples. Explain why the 30 held-out candidates must remain untouched until then.

title: Review all outcomes
instructions: Describe what after-cost average R can and cannot tell you from a small sample. Preserve losing and rejected candidates. Validated dataset counts are required separately.

title: A calm check-in
instructions: Reflect on your emotional state and why fatigue or pressure defaults to study-only. There is no requirement to place a trade.

title: Wait for closed evidence
instructions: Explain what you must document before an H1 confirmation can be evaluated, including the pre-existing H4 zone and manual news check.

title: Record the honest outcome
instructions: Describe how you will keep valid no-trade decisions separate from executions and retain rule breaches even when an execution wins.

title: Review the week
instructions: Review what helped your process and one change for next week. Forward-trade milestones will use validated journal records, not this reflection.

title: Compare like with like
instructions: Explain how you will compare development, held-out and forward demo results without pooling them.

title: Recurring mistakes
instructions: Reflect on recurring process mistakes. Distinguish poor outcomes under the rules from profitable rule breaches.

title: Drawdown needs equity records
instructions: Describe why maximum drawdown needs chronological account equity records and cash-flow context. Missing equity history remains unavailable.

title: Evidence before confidence
instructions: Review sample size, losses, costs and adherence. Reflection alone does not establish readiness or profitability.

title: Read the programme rules
instructions: Document the provider rules you intend to verify: daily and total loss, equity treatment, reset timezone and the rule-set timestamp.

title: Keep simulations free
instructions: Explain how you will document a free evaluation. If a chosen provider has no free trial, postpone rather than substituting a paid evaluation.

title: Reset-time practice
instructions: Describe how an external trial calculates its daily reset and open exposure. Automated simulation support is a later release.

title: Review trial evidence
instructions: Reflect on externally documented results and any rule breaches. Two verified free evaluations require their own evidence; notes do not pass that gate.

title: Audit the full record
instructions: Review historical and forward evidence, including losing periods, missing records and divergence between samples.

title: Affordability and eligibility
instructions: Document what fee affordability, identity eligibility and current payout terms would require you to verify independently.

title: An unpressured decision
instructions: Write your reasons for postponing, declining or independently reviewing a possible evaluation. No purchase is required.

title: Keep the learning routine
instructions: Write a sustainable process for the next month, regardless of the evaluation decision. This curriculum never enables real-money orders.
